name: Independent Books v1.1.0 (Tally Prime Parity & GST Edition)
highlights: Official GSTR-1 (B2B, B2CL, B2CS, HSN) and GSTR-3B with 1-click JSON export for GST Portal
Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS) with clear-date tracking and automated reconciliation
Credit Control & Period Locking (Debtor credit limits, overdue checks, and period lock)
Cost Centres & Cost Categories allocation tracking in vouchers
Manufacturing & Bill of Materials (BOM) multi-godown component tracking
Company PIN Lock & Master Password for data privacy
Automated Update Checker to keep your accounting engine up to date
